text: Long catch-up with Carmen. Her dad had a fall on the stairs and fractured his wrist, cast comes off November 12th. She's been driving over to Leeds every weekend and sounds knackered. Her brother Tomás is meant to help but works nights. Her own driving test is December 2nd and she's had zero time to practise. Ask if she wants me to take her out for a lesson.
Kofi passed his driving test!! Third attempt. Layla says he's already asking to borrow her car. Need to send him a proper congrats message tonight.

Coffee with Elif and Rebecca. Elif is moving to Glasgow in March 2027 for the new job, flat viewings lined up for January. Rebecca's not thrilled, they've shared a flat for six years. Rebecca is a nurse at the Royal, still on nights.

Omar's son Yusuf has tonsillitis again, third time since September. They're seeing an ENT on 11/4 about getting them out. Omar looked shattered. His wife Rana is off work with a bad back too, so he's doing everything. Check in with him after the appointment, and maybe offer to do a school run.

Rana's audition for the conservatory is June 3rd. She's practising four hours a day and barely sleeping, properly nervous. Her mum keeps telling her it's fine which isn't helping. Text her good luck the night before.
Picked up the keys for the new place. Movers booked for 2 November 2026, internet goes live on the 5th.
Siddharth and Natasha viewed a two-bed in Bristol on Saturday and put an offer in. They hear back Friday. He's anxious because they lost the last one at the final hurdle.
Lior said her A level results came through in August but the retake is May 14. Wants to do medicine at Edinburgh. Remind me to ask how revision is going around Easter.
Mustafa's mum is in hospital with pneumonia. She's 82. He's flying out to Izmir tomorrow and isn't sure for how long. Must ring him at the weekend.
Esther from work - vegetarian, allergic to cashews, has a greyhound called Biscuit. Lives in Hackney with her partner Owen.

Helen cancelled the housewarming, the boiler packed in the day they moved and they've no hot water. Still settling in, she says the new street is lovely though. Tunde is apparently living in the shed with his records.

Aaliyah got into the Royal Ballet summer intensive! Starts July 7th 2027. Her sister Zara told me, Aaliyah hasn't announced it yet. Get her something small, she mentioned wanting new pointe shoe ribbons.
Did the theory test, passed. Practical booked for 12/9.

Sadia rang. Her daughter broke her ankle at netball, surgery on Thursday, then six weeks in a boot. Sadia's taking time off work to look after her and is worried about money. I should drop round some food on Friday.
Duc's exam results day was today, he got a 2:1 and was buzzing. Off to Berlin in January for a master's. Jin's helping him look at flats out there already.

Lunch with Luca, Efua and Wei. Luca's knee surgery got moved to February 2027, which he's annoyed about because he'd booked a ski trip. Efua's dad has early dementia, diagnosed in the summer, she's going home to Kumasi for three weeks in December. Wei just started a PhD in marine biology and loves it. Don't forget to send Efua that carer support link.
Ciara's flat viewing on April 22nd went well apparently, she's going for it. First time living alone. Ask how the offer went.
Grocery list: oat milk, bin bags, bulbs for the hallway. Dentist Tuesday 3pm.

Sinead is nervous about her bar exam in February. She failed the first sitting by two marks. Her fiancé Carlos is quizzing her every night. They've also just found out they have to leave their flat by March 2027 because the landlord's daughter is moving in, so it's a lot at once. Carlos says she's barely eating.
Emil said his little boy has chickenpox so they've pulled out of the party Saturday. Lin's covering for him at work till Wednesday.

Alfie (Alf) Kowalski is moving to Manchester on 3/15. Got a job at a games studio. His girlfriend Zara is staying in London for now, they're going to try long distance. He seemed a bit low about it. Leaving drinks are on the 8th at the Crown. His mum's helping him drive the stuff up, and Zara's going for the first weekend to help him settle.
Owen's mum had her scan results back - all clear. He'd been worried sick for weeks. Big relief.
Rebecca says the conservatory move fell through, the buyer pulled out on Monday. They're relisting in the new year. She's pretty fed up.
Tunde and Helen's grade 8 piano exams are both on December 1st, which they think is hilarious. Neither has practised. Helen's goal is just to not cry in the sight reading.

Catch-up with Carlos Gonzalez. Started at the hospital in Seville last month, loves the job, hates the heat. His partner Lin is joining him in spring 2027 once her contract ends. Carlos wants a proper paella pan, he's been dropping hints about it all evening. Their dog Pico has to go through quarantine paperwork first, Lin's dreading it.
Kofi's sister Efua has glandular fever, been off uni for a month. He's worried she'll miss her exams in January. Need to message Efua and see how she's holding up.
Natasha Banerjee mentioned she's retaking the CFA level 2 on May 20th. Works at an investment bank in Canary Wharf. Loves bouldering, goes three times a week.
Jin's dad had a heart attack on Sunday. Stable now, in the cardiac ward at St Thomas'. Jin's staying with his mum. Don't text loads, just one message tomorrow to say thinking of him.
Moving date confirmed: 30 January 2027. Need to book a van and sort the deposit with the old landlord before then.
Siddharth (Sid) and Rana got engaged at the weekend!! Wedding probably summer 2028. Rana's brother Omar is apparently already planning the stag. Send them a card.
Wei's driving test got cancelled last minute, examiner off sick. Rebooked for 1/18. He'd worked himself up so much for it, poor guy.

Talked to Layla for ages. Her mum's hip replacement is October 29th and Layla's taking her in and staying the first night. Layla's also mid move herself, completing on the 4th of November, so it's chaos. Her partner Duc has taken a week off to pack. She said a decent bottle of red would not go amiss. Maybe drop one round after the 4th.
Mrs Khan next door told me her grandson's starting at Leeds uni next September, studying law. She's very proud.
Elif Yilmaz has migraines most weeks now, seeing a neurologist on Nov 9. Hates bright offices. Her boss has been decent about it.
Esther's daughter Ruth has her 11 plus on September 14th next year. Esther's more stressed than Ruth is. They've hired a tutor.
Luca rang from the new flat in Lisbon. Moved in on Friday, everything still in boxes. Says the neighbours have a parrot that swears in Portuguese. Coming back for Christmas on December 20th.
Remind me: Sadia's driving test is 4/2. She'll want a text that morning.
Mustafa says his dad's back home from hospital now, walking with a frame. Physio twice a week. He sounded much more like himself. His wife Aaliyah is doing most of the appointments.
Ciara and Sinead are flatmates again! Moving into a place in Rathmines on December 1, 2026. Ciara's cat Pickle is coming too, Sinead is allergic so that should be interesting.
Uncle Tunde's knee is playing up again, he's had to stop his Saturday walking group. Physio appointment on the 28th. Auntie says he's sulking.
Omar's medical school interview at King's is December 9th. He's done three mock interviews with his cousin Alfie who's a junior doctor. Seemed calm about it, honestly. Ask him how it went after.

Dinner at Carmen's. Her partner Emil just found out he passed his citizenship test. Their twins start reception in September 2027 and they're viewing houses near the good primary. Carmen's mum is coming over from Valencia for Christmas, staying till January 6th. Emil asked me to help move a sofa on Sunday, which I said I'd do. Carmen still won't eat anything with coriander in it.
Kofi's moving out of his mum's on the 15th. First flat, a studio in Peckham. Said he needs literally everything, a toaster would be a start.
Wei mentioned his daughter Mei has been off school all week with a high fever. Doctor thinks it's flu. He's working from home and running on no sleep.
Lin passed her nursing finals!! Results came out Monday. Starts on the paediatric ward on February 1st. Remind me to send flowers this week.
Need to renew passport before March 2027.
Helen Lewis: physio, runs half marathons, two kids (Archie and Bea), lives out in Kent. Her husband Tomás teaches maths.
Natasha's brother had a bike accident last week, broken collarbone and concussion. He's staying with her in Brighton while he recovers. She's working around him. I should check on her next week.

Spent the afternoon with Rana. Her viola recital on May 3rd 2027 is her final assessment for the degree, she's terrified about the Bartok. Her teacher thinks she's ready. Her girlfriend Sadia is making her do yoga to calm down. Rana's after a new shoulder rest, the one she has is held together with tape.
Duc mentioned his landlord's selling, so he has to be out by the end of January. Viewing three flats Saturday. Annoyed because he only moved in last year.
Efua says the kids both had norovirus over half term. Everyone's fine now. They're off to Accra for her cousin's wedding on December 27.
Catch-up with Alfie. Not much news, still at the same job, still obsessed with Warhammer. His birthday's 7/22.

Siddharth's mum is having a knee replacement on November 18th. He's going back to Pune for two weeks to be with her. Asked if I could feed his cat Mochi, said yes. Need to get his spare key before the 17th.
Tomás finally got his driving licence after four tries. His wife Rebecca says he's insufferable now. Their son Leo has his first swimming gala on Saturday.
Emil's back from the clinic, the specialist thinks it's a slipped disc. MRI on 12/3. He's working from bed. Message him that evening to see what they found.
Sinead's brother Cian failed his driving test this morning, minor on the roundabout. Gutted. He rebooks in the spring.

Rebecca's moving to Toronto in August 2027 with her husband Owen, he got a transfer. She's excited but worried about her dad, who's not been well since the stroke. Her sister Ciara will be nearby for him. Say I'll come visit, and ask about a farewell thing for her.
Aaliyah failed the first part of her driving theory. Retake November 7th. She's a bit embarrassed so maybe don't bring it up in front of the others.
Lior and her husband Jin are moving to Haifa next summer to be near her parents. Her mum has MS and it's getting harder. Lior's still teaching until July 2027.
Mustafa's grade 5 guitar exam result came in, distinction! Took it at 41, very proud of himself. He's started looking at grade 6 pieces. Get him a new strap.
